astra-effort-enum.protects: Astra ladder starts at Low and ends at Max
astra-effort-enum.value: low , medium , high , xhigh , and max

sol-effort-enum.protects: Sol is the one model here whose API accepts None
sol-effort-enum.value: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max

codex-level-ladder.protects: Max deepens one run; Ultra divides work across subagents (the page no longer numbers the client rungs)
codex-level-ladder.value: Max gives the selected model more time to reason about a single task. Use it for the hardest problems, when depth matters more than speed or usage. If you don’t see Max in the ChatGPT desktop app, check your app settings. Ultra uses subagents to handle separate parts of a complex task in parallel.

chatgpt-ultra-mode.protects: Ultra organizes work rather than deepening one run
chatgpt-ultra-mode.value: It uses subagents to accelerate complex work, making it useful for larger tasks that can be split across subagents.

chatgpt-astra-power-options.protects: An app menu can show fewer levels than the API
chatgpt-astra-power-options.value: Luna High, GPT-6 Sol Light (selected in this example), GPT-6 Sol Medium, Astra Light, Astra Medium, and Astra Extra High | Some paid plans omit Astra Extra High

subagents-ultra-availability.protects: Ultra is gated, and is maximum reasoning plus delegation
subagents-ultra-availability.value: eligible accounts and supported models | maximum reasoning and lets ChatGPT proactively delegate suitable work to subagents

subagents-intelligence-levels.protects: The composer levels differ from the API enum
subagents-intelligence-levels.value: Light , Medium , High , Extra High , and Max , depending on the selected model

subagents-effort-values.protects: ultra is an effort value in the agent-configuration namespace
subagents-effort-values.value: ultra : Use for the deepest reasoning when the selected model supports it. max and xhigh : Use for especially demanding reasoning when the selected model supports these levels.

subagents-inheritance.protects: Subagents inherit the parent model and effort
subagents-inheritance.value: the parent agent’s model and reasoning effort

codex-delegation-trigger.protects: A client can withhold behavior the setting name implies
codex-delegation-trigger.value: delegate when you ask directly or when applicable AGENTS.md or skill instructions request it

anthropic-effort-models.protects: Which Claude models accept effort at all
anthropic-effort-models.value: - claude-fable-5-1 - claude-mythos-5-1 - claude-fable-5 - claude-mythos-5 - claude-mythos-preview - claude-opus-5-5 - claude-opus-5 - claude-sonnet-5-5 - claude-sonnet-5 - claude-haiku-5-5 - claude-opus-4-8 - claude-opus-4-7 - claude-opus-4-6 - claude-sonnet-4-6 - claude-opus-4-5-20251101

anthropic-default-effort.protects: High is the documented Anthropic default on most models; Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to Medium
anthropic-default-effort.value: high effort, spending as many tokens as needed for excellent results; Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 default to medium

anthropic-high-equivalence.protects: A model’s default level is exactly the same as omitting the parameter
anthropic-high-equivalence.value: `"medium"` on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, `"high"` on other models | exactly the same behavior as omitting the `effort` parameter entirely

anthropic-effort-scope.protects: Anthropic effort covers all output tokens, not only thinking
anthropic-effort-scope.value: * Text responses and explanations * Tool calls and function arguments * Thinking (when active)

anthropic-xhigh-gap.protects: The Anthropic ladder is not uniform across every model
anthropic-xhigh-gap.value: Not every model that supports `max` supports `xhigh`.

anthropic-behavioral-signal.protects: Effort is not a token budget

opus5-thinking-lock.protects: Opus 5 refuses disabled thinking at the top two rungs
opus5-thinking-lock.value: requests that set `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` at those levels return a 400 error

claude-code-ultracode.protects: Ultracode adds workflows at any effort level, not a sixth API rung
claude-code-ultracode.value: A Claude Code setting rather than a level: plans a [dynamic workflow](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows.md) for each substantive task at any effort level
